deduction: The native race can return while its original planner/orchestrator promise remains pending. Current Hybrid checks its signal, which covers its own normal path, but the managed catalog also admits other planners/orchestrators and native service ports do not themselves authenticate turn-terminal admission. R2 keeps an original producer ACTIVE for liveness, and concretely denies new child work on owner.close; it does not explicitly distinguish that liveness from permission to create a new model/tool callback after a native turn result/deadline/cancel while owner remains OPEN. A broad no-budget-bypass clause is not a concrete latch placement.
scope: No engine exploitation claimed; source tests and hypothetical schedule NOT_RUN. Ordinary native Hybrid signal guard is preserved as positive boundary; do not label it broken.
requiredBeforeHumanPresentation: State the separate monotonic per-turn body-admission latch and signal/budget checks at the real invocation boundary, while retaining liveness/settlement tokens for original pending operations.
